restaurant.name: BJ Buffet
restaurant.tagline: Authentic Southern Home Cooking & Country Buffet
restaurant.description: BJ Buffet in Conyers, GA serves up comforting, country home-style cooking and traditional Southern soul food. Featuring daily all-you-can-eat buffet spreads with golden fried chicken, slow-simmered beef tips, creamy mac and cheese, collard greens, candied yams, fresh salad bar, and homemade peach cobbler, plus build-your-own to-go plates and delivery.

location.landmark: Located on Hwy 138 behind the Truist Bank Building, right next to the bowling alley

hours.special: Country Fried Pork Chops & Baked Chicken

services: Delivery via UberEats, DoorDash, Postmates & Grubhub

reviews.author: Marcus Thornton
reviews.text: If you're looking for real home-cooked comfort food that tastes like Sunday dinner at your grandmother's house, BJ Buffet is the real deal here in Conyers. The fried chicken was piping hot and seasoned to perfection with crisp, flaky skin. The mac and cheese was rich and creamy, not watery like at other buffets. You cannot beat the value for an all-you-can-eat spread. Clean tables and great hospitality!

reviews.author: Brenda Washington
reviews.text: We brought our family group of 8 after Sunday service. Everyone found multiple things they thoroughly enjoyed. The candied yams were tender with that perfect caramel glaze, the beef tips over rice were packed with savory gravy, and the hot peach cobbler made my day. Attentive staff kept our sweet teas refilled without having to ask.

reviews.author: David Kowalski
reviews.text: A nice hidden gem tucked behind the Truist Bank building off Highway 138. Much more peaceful and clean than massive commercial chain buffets. The rib tips on Monday are fantastic with good smoky BBQ sauce, and the deviled eggs on the salad bar are always fresh. Great lunch stop!

reviews.author: Patricia Reynolds
reviews.text: I frequently order the to-go 1-meat 2-veggie plate for lunch during my work breaks. The baked chicken and collard greens are consistently good and healthy portions. Sweet ladies at the front counter always greet you with a genuine smile. Conyers staple!

reviews.author: Anthony Bennett
reviews.text: Great old-fashioned soul food buffet. Deviled eggs and cucumber salad on the cold bar were crispy and fresh. The meatloaf tasted 100% homemade, hearty and seasoned just right. Will definitely bring my coworkers back for our Friday team lunches.

reviews.author: Keisha Mitchell
reviews.text: Honest country cooking and sweet hospitality. The fried chicken alone is worth the trip—make sure to grab a piece when they bring out the hot fresh tray! Affordable price for an all-you-can-eat meal in this economy.
